name: finance.stripe.translate
description: Translate simulated bank account values to real Stripe revenue. Monitors enrollments (patient subscriptions, provider subscriptions, consultations) and ensures every real Stripe payment flows into the financial ledger.

steps.name: Check recent Stripe payments not yet in ledger
steps.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as unsynced FROM fin_stripe_bridge WHERE status = 'pending'

steps.name: Get total Stripe revenue vs simulated bank
steps.query: SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(real_amount), 0) FROM fin_stripe_bridge WHERE status = 'completed') as total_real_revenue, (SELECT current_balance FROM fin_bank_accounts WHERE account_number = 'DCTA-STR-001') as stripe_account_balance, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(current_balance), 0) FROM fin_bank_accounts WHERE is_active = true) as total_simulated_cash

steps.name: Analyze translation gap
